SC-100.title: California Judicial Council SC-100, Plaintiff's Claim and ORDER to Go to Small Claims Court (Rev. January 1, 2026)
notes: Plaintiff fills pages 2-4 plus the page-1 court name/address box. Clerk fills case number, trial dates, clerk signature; the court fills the page 5/6 'Need help?' boxes.
Yes/No questions (items 4, 7, 8, 9, 10) are pairs of separate checkboxes: [0] is Yes (checked value /1), [1] is No (checked value /2). Check exactly one per pair.
Item 5 a-e are five separate checkboxes with checked values /1../5; check exactly one. Item 6 is the zip of that place.

Item 3 amount: '$' is pre-printed — write the figure without '$', as the facts state it (e.g. 1500 or 1,500.00). Item 10 (more than $2,500?) follows from the item 3 amount; the fill script sets/enforces it.
Plaintiff (list names) header repeats on pages 2, 3, 4 with identical text; the fill script copies it if only one is given.
Mailing-address fields only when different from the street address. Agent-for-service fields only for corporation/LLC/public-entity defendants.
Limits: individuals may claim up to $12,500; corporations/partnerships/public entities/other businesses up to $6,250. At most two claims over $2,500 per calendar year.
Before suing a public entity a written claim must have been filed with it first (item 8).
